meta.name: cost-accounting
meta.description: Establishes what something actually costs — fixed, variable and mixed cost behavior, absorption versus variable costing, job-order, process and activity-based methods, breakeven and operating leverage, and price/volume/mix decomposition. Use this to set a price floor, explain why revenue or margin moved, decide make versus buy, judge whether a product line earns its place, or work out how an allocation basis is distorting a reported margin.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核算真实成本,拆解利润变动,定出价格底线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你要算清产品成本、为定价或盈亏分析发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate true product costs and set data-driven price floors.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand cost structure and make informed pricing or make-or-buy decisions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把成本拆成固定、变动、混合三类,区分吸收成本法与变动成本法,按业务形态选用分批、分步或作业成本法,计算盈亏平衡点和经营杠杆,并拆分价格、销量、产品结构对收入变化的影响,用于定价、自制或外购等决策。
howto.when: 当你要求定价格下限、解释收入或利润变动的原因、决定自制还是外购,等进行成本分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我算这个产品的盈亏平衡点,并解释经营杠杆。
say.note: 会区分固定与变动成本后计算。

say.text: 上季度收入涨了,帮我拆一下价格、销量和产品结构各贡献多少。
say.note: 会把收入变化拆成价格、数量、结构三部分。

say.text: 这个零件该自制还是外购?请用成本数据帮我分析。
say.note: 会按相关成本给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude classifies costs as fixed, variable, or mixed, distinguishes absorption from variable costing, chooses the fitting costing method, computes breakeven and operating leverage, and splits revenue changes into price, volume, and mix.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to set a price floor, explain why revenue or margin moved, decide whether to make or buy, or for similar cost-analysis tasks.

say_en.text: Calculate this product's breakeven point and explain operating leverage.
say_en.note: Computes breakeven after separating fixed and variable costs.

say_en.text: Revenue rose last quarter; decompose it into price, volume, and mix.
say_en.note: Splits the change into price, volume, and mix effects.

say_en.text: Should we make or buy this part? Analyze it with cost data.
say_en.note: Compares relevant costs to support the decision.
